changes: Implemented Wave 1A verifier-derived acceptance coverage basis with bounded registered discovery, deterministic reconciliation, structured signed snapshot seals, freshness verification, and read-only diagnostics.
usage: Run lattice acceptance_basis_generate through the registered verifier to create the signed basis, then run lattice acceptance_basis --storyId=<id> --json to inspect its verified status and diagnostics.
expectedOutcome: The CLI reports only verifier-derived complete, partial, or unsupported status, binds the basis to current scope and workspace facts, and rejects caller-forged completion or stale/tampered receipts.
actualTranscript: A real production CLI capture ran node bin/lattice.js acceptance_basis --storyId=B-a32a --json and returned exit 0 with read_only mode, evidentiary false, bounded unsupported status, and AT_COVERAGE_BASIS_MISSING for this legacy Story artifact state.
outcomeDiff: The observed bounded unsupported result exactly matches the documented legacy-missing behavior; the full generated-basis path and mutation controls passed the focused production-chain smoke and the fresh 46-command validation.
pitfalls: A diagnostic read never creates or upgrades evidence; callers must use the registered verifier writer, and the full validation requires an explicit CLI max-time budget above the default 900 seconds in this repository configuration.
